address: Lazaridis School of Business and Economics, University Avenue West, Waterloo, ON, Canada
description: Our General Meetings are the cornerstone to our programming activities and is open to any Laurier student looking to get introduced, involved or connected into the finance and related industries. Weekly lessons are taught by some of Laurier's brightest and are designed to give LIFA members a strong understanding of businesses through a financial lens. The goal of our General Meeting sessions is to create a strong ecosystem of students working towards careers in finance.
